title: 17 Dec pro-candidacy youth mobilization
reason: La Nation reports a large gathering in Djibouti City and five interior regions with several thousand at the stadium, whose demand was that President Guelleh run in the April 2021 election. This is an election-linked support rally, excluded under the codebook.
